content.question: What characterizes leave-p-out cross-validation?
options: In each iteration, p samples are held out as the validation set, and the model is trained on the remaining data.
The dataset is randomly split into p folds of equal size.
The model is trained p times on the same training set.
p percent of the samples are removed from the dataset before training.
content.answer: In each iteration, p samples are held out as the validation set, and the model is trained on the remaining data.
